title: Rope snaps taut across the path — an ambush
description: Figures drop from the branches, daggers already out. "Thirty gold," one hisses through a cloth mask, "and you keep your blood."

onPass.narration: Coin changes hands. The ropes go slack and the trees swallow them whole, as if they were never there.

onFail.narration: Your purse is too light, and they take that personally.

onPass.narration: "Wrong answer," the masked one sighs — and the thicket comes alive.
You break formation and melt into the thicket before they can close the net. Their curses fade behind you.

onFail.narration: A tripline catches an ankle. By the time you're up, they're on you.
